He played [[college basketball]] for the [[San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball|San Diego State Aztecs]]. ==High school career== As a freshman, Mitchell helped [[Martin Luther King High School (Riverside, California)|Martin Luther King High School]] in [[Riverside, California]] win the [[CIF Southern Section]] Division 1A championship.{{cite web |title=King wins another CIF title |url=https://www.pressenterprise.com/2014/03/10/boys-basketball-king-wins-another-cif-title/ |website=[[The Press-Enterprise]] |access-date=June 28, 2020 |date=March 10, 2014}} After the season, he transferred to [[Eleanor Roosevelt High School (California)|Eleanor Roosevelt High School]] in [[Eastvale, California]]. As a senior, Mitchell averaged 25.4 points, 9.5 rebounds, three assists and 2.2 steals per game, recording 16 [[double (basketball)|double-doubles]] and scoring least 30 points in 10 games. He led Roosevelt to CIF State Division I, CIF Southern California Regional and Big VIII League titles. Mitchell was named HSGametime Player of the Year by ''[[The Press-Enterprise]]''.{{cite web |last1=Parenti |first1=Jeffrey |title=Roosevelt's Matt Mitchell is the HSGametime Boys Basketball Player of the Year |url=https://www.pressenterprise.com/2017/04/22/roosevelts-matt-mitchell-is-the-hsgametime-boys-basketball-player-of-the-year/ |website=[[The Press-Enterprise]] |access-date=June 28, 2020 |date=April 22, 2017}} He had success with Dream Vision on the [[Amateur Athletic Union]] circuit.{{cite web |last1=Zeigler |first1=Mark |title=Star hoops recruit Matt Mitchell commits to SDSU |url=https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/sports/aztecs/sd-sp-mitchell-sdsu-20170814-story.html |website=[[The San Diego Union-Tribune]] |accessdate=June 28, 2020 |date=August 14, 2017}} Mitchell initially committed and signed a [[National Letter of Intent]] to play [[college basketball]] for [[Cal State Fullerton Titans men's basketball|Cal State Fullerton]].{{cite web |last1=Alexander |first1=Jim |title=Roosevelt's Mitchell stays cool at end |url=https://www.pressenterprise.com/2017/03/19/alexander-roosevelts-mitchell-stays-cool-at-end/ |website=[[The Press-Enterprise]] |access-date=June 28, 2020 |date=March 19, 2017}} After his senior season, he reopened his recruitment and committed to [[San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball|San Diego State]]. Mitchell was considered a three-star recruit by most recruiting services. ==College career== On November 20, 2017, in his fourth collegiate game, Mitchell scored a career-high 31 points, 26 of which came in the second half, in a 94–63 win over [[Eastern Illinois Panthers men's basketball|Eastern Illinois]]. He shot 7-of-11 from three-point range and scored the most points for a San Diego State freshman since Evan Burns in 2003.{{cite web |last1=Zeigler |first1=Mark |title=Freshman scores 31 in impressive SDSU win |url=https://www.dailypress.com/dailypress/sd-sp-sdsu-basketball-eastern-illinois-20171120-story.html |website=[[Daily Press (California)|Daily Press]] |accessdate=June 28, 2020 |date=November 21, 2017}} As a freshman, Mitchell averaged 10.5 points and four rebounds per game.{{cite web |title=San Diego State Basketball Freshman Report: Matt Mitchell, Jalen McDaniels and Jordan Schakel |url=https://mwwire.com/2018/05/07/san-diego-state-basketball-freshman-report-matt-mitchell-jalen-mcdaniels-and-jordan-schakel/ |publisher=Mountain West Wire |accessdate=June 28, 2020 |date=May 7, 2018 |archive-date=May 12, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210512151828/https://mwwire.com/2018/05/07/san-diego-state-basketball-freshman-report-matt-mitchell-jalen-mcdaniels-and-jordan-schakel/ |url-status=dead }} On December 22, 2018, he scored a sophomore season-high 22 points, shooting 9-of-12 from the field, in a 90–81 victory over [[BYU Cougars men's basketball|BYU]].{{cite web |title=Watson, Mitchell lead San Diego State to 90-81 win vs BYU |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401083610 |website=[[ESPN]] |publisher=[[Associated Press]] |accessdate=June 28, 2020 |date=December 22, 2018}} As a sophomore, Mitchell averaged 10.3 points and 4.1 rebounds per game. During the season, he gained about 20 pounds.{{cite web |last1=Betz |first1=Kyle |title=New men's basketball season stars new transfers |url=https://thedailyaztec.com/96684/sports/new-mens-basketball-season-stars-new-transfers/ |website=[[The Daily Aztec]] |accessdate=June 28, 2020 |date=October 30, 2019}} In the offseason, he cut down his weight by improving his diet and spending more time in the gym.{{cite web |last1=Zeigler |first1=Mark |title=San Diego State's Matt Mitchell spending summer slimming down |url=https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/sports/aztecs/story/2019-07-22/sdsu-aztecs-basketball-matt-mitchell-losing-weight-swish-pro-am-summer-league |website=[[The San Diego Union-Tribune]] |accessdate=June 28, 2020 |date=July 22, 2019}} On February 1, 2020, Mitchell scored a junior season-high 28 points, including 24 in the second half, in an 80–68 win over [[Utah State Aggies men's basketball|Utah State]].{{cite web |last1=Greene |first1=Dana |title=San Diego State stays unbeaten with 80-68 victory over Utah State |url=https://www.abc4.com/news/top-stories/san-diego-state-stays-unbeaten-with-80-68-victory-over-utah-state/ |publisher=[[KTVX]] |accessdate=June 28, 2020 |date=February 1, 2020 |archive-date=April 13, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210413201227/https://www.abc4.com/news/top-stories/san-diego-state-stays-unbeaten-with-80-68-victory-over-utah-state/ |url-status=dead }} As a junior, he averaged 12.2 points and 4.8 rebounds per game, helping San Diego State achieve a 30–2 record.{{cite web |last1=Zeigler |first1=Mark |title=Aztecs finish season 30-2 as NCAA cancels basketball tournament |url=https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/sports/aztecs/story/2020-03-12/sdsu-aztecs-basketball-ncaa-cancels-tournament-ucsd-point-loma-narazene-div-ii |website=[[The San Diego Union-Tribune]] |accessdate=June 28, 2020 |date=March 12, 2020}} Mitchell earned first-team and second-team All-[[Mountain West Conference|Mountain West]] honors in the coaches and media polls, respectively.{{cite web |title=Matt Mitchell |url=https://goaztecs.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/matt-mitchell/5766 |publisher=SDSU Athletics |accessdate=June 28, 2020}} On April 26, he declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]] while maintaining his college eligibility.{{cite web |last1=Zeigler |first1=Mark |title=SDSU's Matt Mitchell says he's not 'looking to leave this year' for NBA |url=https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/sports/aztecs/story/2020-04-27/san-diego-state-sdsu-aztecs-matt-mitchell-nba-draft-return-workouts-clippers |website=[[The San Diego Union-Tribune]] |date=April 27, 2020 |accessdate=June 28, 2020}} Mitchell announced he was withdrawing from the draft on August 1.{{cite news |title=Matt Mitchell forgoes NBA draft to return for senior season at San Diego State |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/29573450/matt-mitchell-forgoes-nba-draft-return-senior-season-san-diego-state |accessdate=August 2, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=August 1, 2020}} On December 18, he scored a career-high 35 points in a 72–62 loss to BYU.{{cite web |last1=Honda |first1=Breven |title=Mitchell scores career-high, Aztecs' comeback bid falls short in upset loss to Brigham Young |url=https://thedailyaztec.com/103357/sports/mitchell-scores-career-high-aztecs-comeback-bid-falls-short-in-upset-loss-to-brigham-young/ |website=[[The Daily Aztec]] |access-date=January 8, 2021 |date=December 18, 2020}} At the close of his senior season, Mitchell was named [[Mountain West Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Mountain West Player of the Year]].{{cite press release|url=https://themw.com/news/2021/3/9/mountain-west-reveals-2020-21-mens-basketball-all-conference-teams.aspx|title=Mountain West Reveals 2020-21 Men's Basketball All-Conference Teams|publisher=[[Mountain West Conference]] |date=March 9, 2021 |access-date=March 9, 2021}} He averaged 15.4 points, 5.6 rebounds and 2.0 assists per game. Mitchell declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]] and hired an agent.{{cite news |last1=Kalbrosky |first1=Bryan |title=Source: SDSU's Matt Mitchell has hired an agent, declared for 2021 NBA Draft |url=https://therookiewire.usatoday.com/2021/04/18/matt-mitchell-nba-draft-stock-early-entry-sleepers/ |access-date=June 21, 2021 |work=The Rookie Wire |date=April 18, 2021}} ==Professional career== After going undrafted in the [[2021 NBA draft]], Mitchell signed with the [[San Antonio Spurs]] for Summer League.{{cite news |last1=Zeigler |first1=Mark |title=SDSU's Schakel, Mitchell go undrafted but not unsigned |url=https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/sports/aztecs/story/2021-07-30/san-diego-state-sdsu-aztecs-basketball-jordan-schakel-golden-state-warriors-matt-mitchell-san-antonio-spurs |access-date=August 3, 2021 |work=[[The San Diego Union-Tribune]] |date=July 30, 2021}} On August 2, 2021, Mitchell signed with [[SIG Strasbourg]] of the [[LNB Pro A]].{{cite news |title=SIG Strasbourg lands rookie Matt Mitchell |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/sig-strasbourg-lands-rookie-matt-mitchell/ |website=Sportando |access-date=August 3, 2021 |date=August 2, 2021|last1=Skerletic |first1=Dario }} On July 6, 2023, Mitchell signed with [[Beşiktaş J.K. (men's basketball)|Beşiktaş]] of the Turkish [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).{{Cite web|url=https://bjk.com.tr/tr/haber/86514/matt-mitchell-besiktasta.html|title= Matt Mitchell Beşiktaş'ta|last=|first=|date=July 6, 2023|website=|publisher=[[Beşiktaş J.K. (men's basketball)|Beşiktaş]]|language=tr|access-date=July 6, 2023}} On June 27, 2024, Mitchell signed a two-year (1+1) contract with [[BC Žalgiris|Žalgiris Kaunas]] of the [[Lietuvos krepšinio lyga|Lithuanian Basketball League]] (LKL) and the [[EuroLeague]].{{cite web|last=Gillingham|first=Geoff|title=Matt Mitchell heads to Zalgiris|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/matt-mitchell-heads-to-zalgiris-kaunas/|website=[[EuroLeague]]|date=June 27, 2024|accessdate=June 27, 2024}} On July 11, 2025, he was released from the Lithuanian club. On July 14, 2025, he signed with [[Bahçeşehir Koleji S.K.|Bahçeşehir Koleji]] of the Turkish [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).{{Cite tweet |user=BKBasketbol |number=1944755147327840520 |title=Matt Mitchell Bahçeşehir Koleji'nde}} On August 12, 2026, he signed with [[Körfez Basket]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).{{Cite tweet |user=glintkorfez |number=2087581604889702789 |title=Matt
